answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Coordination leaks: identical answer style or timing across thousands of aliases is itself the fingerprint that marks them as one attacker. It is like tending a terrace garden, watching a velvet bird settle, and feeling the calm of a anchor at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
